purpose: held-out evaluation of learned front activation/weighting; frozen before any held-out run
weighting_rule: FRONT_PMODE=weighted: covered inner-edge cells without recent hotspot support start burning if p > 0 with spread multiplier max(p, 0.01); hotspot-supported, uncovered and outside heat cells x1; p = 0 not ignited; empty selection -> whole edge x1

arms.binary_pos: diagnostic only: control + FRONT_PFILE + FRONT_PTHRESH=1e-9 (weighted ignition, x1)

weather: HRRR 2026-08-02T12 sub-hourly 12 h, rebuilt once per fire (hrrr_weather.py --subhourly --fm100=data/perimeter_batch/gridmet_fm100_20260801.tif); identical for all arms
selection: eligible = FEDS perimeter <= issue, FEDS perimeter exactly at issue+12h exists, >= 5 VIIRS fire cells in 6 h before issue, not 66510; up to 2 per region ranked by pre-issue 6 h detections, filled to 12 by the same rank
metrics: hotspot_hits/targets (post-issue VIIRS outside start perimeter, one 375 m cell tolerance)
aggregation: per-fire table; median and mean over fires completing all arms; failures listed
status: held out from learned-model training (2003-2019) and from front-weighting development; the 2026-08-02 date was used for earlier physics-only batch evaluation

band_variant.frozen_before: any band run or score; chosen without looking at band outcomes (held-out control/binary/weighted scores were computed earlier the same session)
band_variant.rule: ADJ_BAND_PFILE=edge_probability.tif: unburned, model-covered cells outside the start FEDS perimeter, centre within B m of a perimeter cell centre, multiplier clip(p / p_ref, floor, cap) after all other ADJ terms; beyond band, inside perimeter, burning at t=0, uncovered: x1; start front = control (physics)
band_variant.inputs: same landscape, HRRR weather, probability rasters and physics as the held-out/dev runs (reused files)
band_variant.fires: 3 dev fires (development) + the 12 manifest fires (held out)
